prompt: The retry helper in src/backoff.js and src/retry.js is wrong in several ways. Fix all of them: (1) computeDelay must be exponential, returning baseDelayMs * 2^attempt for attempt starting at 0, capped at maxDelayMs, then multiplied by a jitter factor of (0.5 + 0.5 * random()) and rounded down with Math.floor; (2) retry must attempt the operation at most maxAttempts times in total, not maxAttempts retries after the first call; (3) retry must only retry when isRetryable(error) returns true, and must rethrow immediately otherwise; (4) before each sleep, retry must check the elapsed time from deps.now() against maxElapsedMs and stop retrying if the next delay would exceed the budget, rethrowing the last error; (5) retry must return the operation's resolved value on success. deps supplies now, random, and sleep so the behaviour is deterministic under test. Run `node test/retry.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: computeDelay grows exponentially and is capped at maxDelayMs
Jitter uses the 0.5 to 1.0 multiplier and floors the result
retry performs at most maxAttempts total attempts
Non-retryable errors are rethrown without any retry
The elapsed-time budget stops further retries
retry resolves with the operation's value on success

provenance.incident: Synthetic neutral fixture. Multi-file retry-policy defects with injected clock and randomness for determinism.
